policies.B1: Priority routing status is assigned to a travel agency that attains a customer satisfaction score of 90 or more annually, maintains a fleet size of at least 15 vehicles, or completes 500 transfers per year.
policies.D1: A charter firm is chosen for civic service contracts provided it holds priority routing status and carries liability insurance coverage of 5,000,000 USD or higher.
policies.B2: Cross-border route authorization is granted to any transport vendor possessing an active international charter licence.

decoy_policies: An air cargo handler qualifies for expedited customs processing by maintaining a certified cargo handling facility and completing at least 1,000 freight movements annually.
A marine ferry operator receives a harbour docking permit if it maintains an emergency response rating of 85 or above.
